title: EIDER: Empowering Document-level Relation Extraction with Efficient Evidence Extraction and Inference-stage Fusion
findings: The model failed to infer a 'Religion' relation between a Catholic priest and a Pope, a task that required commonsense reasoning to connect that a Pope removing a priest from ministry implies they belong to the same religion. This was categorized as a 'Fail in Commonsense Reasoning' error.
